applies_why: Yes: the judge is resolving a D5-versus-C5 link collision involving the challenger's and defender's chains, which is the situation K-C governs.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse: one reading permits UNDERDETERMINED from the two sides answering different aspects; the other requires comparing the full chain footings, not separate wording and application.
why: The judge gives no chain-footing ground and instead calls the link underdetermined by separating the challenger's virgin/young-woman wording from the defender's prophetic-application answer, which is not the required chain-against-chain weighing.
